posts.title: Photographing the Prairies
posts.description: Reading Time: 5 minutes Finding Extraordinary Beauty in Canada’s Wide-Open Spaces The Beauty of What Appears Empty Some people believe there is nothing interesting to photograph on the Canadian Prairies. I see precisely the opposite. Across Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba, the horizon stretches beyond imagination, inviting the photographer to discover beauty without the assistance of mountains
